result:
La causa: `tasks.tsx` importa `LocalJSXCommandContext` del re-export de `command-runtime/runtime` (que usa el stub de `command-runtime/src/types.ts`, con campos `unknown` y sin extender `ToolUseContext`), mientras que `LocalJSXCommandOnDone` ya lo importa del módulo real `agent/command.ts`, donde `LocalJSXCommandContext = ToolUseContext & {...}` sí lleva las propiedades que `BackgroundTasksDialog` exige. Corrijo importando ambos tipos del mismo módulo real, dentro del propio archivo.

```json
{"file": "src/packages/agent/commands/tasks/tasks.tsx",
 "edits": [{"old": "import type { LocalJSXCommandContext } from '@thyrox/command-runtime/runtime'\nimport { BackgroundTasksDialog } from '@thyrox/repl/components/tasks/BackgroundTasksDialog.js'\nimport type { LocalJSXCommandOnDone } from '../../command.js'", "new": "import { BackgroundTasksDialog } from '@thyrox/repl/components/tasks/BackgroundTasksDialog.js'\nimport type { LocalJSXCommandContext, LocalJSXCommandOnDone } from '../../command.js'"}],
 "patterns": [{"patron": "local-jsx-context-from-stub-reexport",
               "senal_del_verificador": "TS2740:.*'LocalJSXCommandContext'.*missing.*(properties from type )?'ToolUseContext'",
               "fix_generico": "Importar `LocalJSXCommandContext` desde el módulo real que lo declara como `ToolUseContext & {...}` (`agent/command.ts`, o el equivalente del paquete que lo define con el intersection), en vez de desde un re-export intermedio (p. ej. `command-runtime/runtime`) que resuelve a una versión stub sin la intersección con `ToolUseContext`.",
               "edits": [0]}],
 "fixes": ["src/packages/agent/commands/tasks/tasks.tsx(10,33): error TS2740: Type 'LocalJSXCommandContext' is missing the following properties from type 'ToolUseContext': abortController, readFileState, getAppState, setAppState, and 5 more."],
 "skipped": []}
```
